id: \rIris: Hey! What are you doing here?
en: \rIris: Hey! What are you doing here?

id: \rWhy are you looking at me like that? What!? You thought my hair was a Pokémon?
en: \rWhy are you looking at me like that? What!? You thought my hair was a Pokémon?
it: \rPerché mi guardi così? Cosa!? Pensavi che i miei capelli fossero un Pokémon?

id: \rIris: Fine. I'll let you off with a warning. But don't go assuming people are Pokémon. What are you, a little kid?
en: \rIris: Fine. I'll let you off with a warning. But don't go assuming people are Pokémon. What are you, a little kid?
it: \rIris: E va bene. Per stavolta te la cavi con un avvertimento. Ma non andare in giro a scambiare le persone per Pokémon. Cosa sei, un bambino?
